payload.reader_contract: After the G3.2A phases pass, resolve the canonical feature source root, lstat root and every declared source path, open files with O_NOFOLLOW, fstat-compare before reading, hash raw bytes with SHA-256, compare root identity before and after every read, and reject symlink, hard-link, missing or moving paths.
payload.dependency_contract: Resolve every dependency only through an explicit resolver against the exact feature_release_ref and feature_release_hash; every required_resource_ref must be present in that exact release closure.
payload.side_effect_boundary: The preflight is read-only. It does not read legacy resource keys, write Registry state, publish, activate, or load Production resources.
